states.name: Idle
states.description: Everything off: rollers, shooter, indexer, feeder, slide. Hood to 0.05.

states.name: Intake
states.description: Rollers at 8 V. Hood clears the slide, then the slide runs its intake sequence.

states.name: Shoot
states.description: Shooter spins for the hub (or corner feed); indexer and feeder run once the flywheel is at speed.

states.name: Rev
states.description: In the alliance zone: spin the shooter for the hub without feeding.

states.name: Rev And Intake
states.description: Revving while intaking; slide to ground intake.

states.name: Shoot And Intake
states.description: Shooting and intaking together; slide to ground intake.

states.name: Jitter
states.description: Rollers on and the slide jitters to unjam pieces.

states.name: Home
states.description: Hood 0.05, everything off, slide to ground intake position.

inputs.name: In alliance zone (blue x < 4 m, red x > 12.5 m)

rules.title: Battery sagging for 2 s
rules.detail: Battery stayed under 11.5 V for two seconds. Swap or charge before the next match.

rules.title: Robot browned out
rules.detail: The roboRIO reported a brownout. Check what was drawing current in the seconds before.

source.converted: Old time-optimal .mtraj paths converted to pose goals; markers mirror MayhemAutos.cpp.
markerWarnings: Outpost Trench Sweep x2: OutpostTrenchSweepBumpPt2 has no "intake2" marker (it has idle, intake, shoot), so AtTime("intake2") never fires and the superstructure never goes to INTAKE there.
Outpost Trench Sweep x2: OutpostTrenchSweepBumpPt2 has no "idle2" marker (it has idle, intake, shoot), so AtTime("idle2") never fires and the superstructure never goes to IDLE there.
Depot Trench Sweep x2: DepotTrenchSweepBump2xPt2 has no "intake2" marker (it has idle2, shoot2), so AtTime("intake2") never fires and the superstructure never goes to INTAKE there.
Depot Trench Sweep Depot: DepotTrenchSweepDepotPt has no "idle" marker (it has intake, shoot), so AtTime("idle") never fires and the superstructure never goes to IDLE there.
